title: Retrieval-Based Assignment of Diagnosis Codes to Clinical Notes
technical_field: Medical coding and natural language processing
problem: Assigning billing and diagnosis codes to free-text clinical notes is slow and error prone, and classifiers trained on frequent codes fail on the long tail of rare codes.
solution: The system embeds each sentence of a clinical note and retrieves the most similar code descriptions and previously coded sentences from an index. A ranking model scores the retrieved candidates using the note context, and codes above a confidence threshold are proposed to a human coder together with the supporting sentences.

elements.text: Segmentation of a clinical note into sentences
Embedding of each sentence into a vector representation
An index of code descriptions and previously coded sentences searched by vector similarity
Retrieval of candidate diagnosis codes for each sentence from the index
A ranking model that scores the candidate codes using context from the note
Presentation to a human coder of codes above a confidence threshold with the supporting sentences

dependent_features: Rare codes are boosted using their description embedding
Coder corrections are added to the index
